rca_of_issue.bug: inbox-outline icon renders as '?' in profile.tsx and received.tsx
rca_of_issue.root_cause: Ionicons v5 (@expo/vector-icons 15.1.1) does not include an icon named 'inbox-outline'. The icon lookup fails silently and renders a '?' placeholder character.
rca_of_issue.fix_applied: Replaced 'inbox-outline' with 'mail-open-outline' in both affected files. mail-open-outline is a valid Ionicons 5 icon that semantically represents received/opened messages.
